name: German Health Insurance KVNR GKV §290 SGB V Checksum
description: Validates German statutory health insurance numbers (KVNR / Krankenversicherungsnummer) per GKV-Spitzenverband §290 SGB V. The leading letter is replaced by its 2-digit ordinal (A=01..Z=26), giving 10 effective digits. Alternating factors [1,2,1,2,1,2,1,2,1,2] are applied with Luhn cross-sum (products >= 10 have their digits summed). The total mod 10 must equal the check digit at position 10.
